title: kw-bench: Breaking Frontier Harnesses on Real-World Tasks
title_zh: kw-bench：在真实任务上击破前沿 harness

paragraphs.en: kw-bench用真实业务案例测试编码智能体harness，显示前沿模型下任务轻松完成而harness决定成败。 Each new generation of frontier model pushes the edge of what is possible. Inside a harness -- a loop, a shell, a filesystem, the ability to write and run its own code -- a model can take on increasingly difficult work. A growing body of work treats the coding-agent harness as infrastructure for knowledge work rather than a coding tool, and a new wave of benchmarks tests it there. Most of them are generative: build a financial model, a memo, a spreadsheet from a brief, judged by a rubric or by another model. Few test the expensive part of knowledge work, which is investigative. In audit, tax, due diligence, regulatory reporting, claims or any dispute over numbers, the answer already exists -- hidden in incomplete and inconsistent evidence spread across systems -- and has to be recovered and defended to the cent. We introduce kw-bench, a benchmark built from real engagements specialists described to us. Its first task family is a five-year VAT reconstruction across three generations of SAP -- legacy ECC, a partial S/4HANA migration and a consultant's redesign -- delivered as raw system extracts: page headers, local number formats, partial link tables, no documentation of how anything connects. Grading is deterministic, with no LLM judge. We ran four harnesses -- Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and micro-cc -- on the same model, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, for two hours. The two independent, model-agnostic harnesses delivered (OpenCode 0.542, micro-cc 0.528); the two lab harnesses, away from their home model, delivered nothing (0.00 each). What defeated them was inertia: keeping many weak signals alive across a long session. On a frontier model the task collapses. micro-cc and Claude Code on Claude Opus 5.5 scored 0.9986 and 1.000, in 22 and 25 minutes. A weeks-long engagement now costs minutes and a few dollars; below the frontier, the harness decides how far a model gets.
paragraphs.zh: kw-bench 用真实业务案例测试编码智能体 harness，结果显示在前沿模型下任务轻松完成，而 harness 决定成败。每一代新的前沿模型都在拓展可能性的边界。 在一个 harness 内部——一个循环、一个 shell、一个文件系统、编写并运行自己代码的能力——模型可以承担越来越困难的工作。 越来越多的研究将编码智能体 harness 视为知识工作的基础设施，而非单纯的编码工具，新一波的基准测试正是在这一领域对其进行检验。 其中大多数是生成式的：根据一份简报构建财务模型、备忘录或电子表格，由评分量表或另一个模型来评判。 很少有测试检验知识工作中昂贵的部分，即调查性的工作。 在审计、税务、尽职调查、监管报告、理赔或任何涉及数字的争议中，答案其实早已存在——隐藏在分散于各个系统、不完整且不一致的证据之中——并且必须被恢复出来，还要精确到分毫不差地加以辩护。 我们推出 kw-bench，这是一个由专家向我们描述的真实业务案例构建而成的基准。 其首个任务族是一项跨越三代 SAP 的五年期增值税（VAT）重构——旧版 ECC、一次不完整的 S/4HANA 迁移，以及一位顾问的重新设计——以原始系统导出数据的形式交付：页眉、本地数字格式、不完整的链接表，没有任何说明文档来解释各部分如何关联。 评分是确定性的，不使用 LLM 评判。 我们在同一个模型 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 上运行了四个 harness——Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 和 micro-cc——历时两小时。 两个独立的、与模型无关的 harness 交出了成果（OpenCode 0.542，micro-cc 0.528）；而两个实验室 harness 远离其原生模型，一无所获（各为 0.00）。 击败它们的是惯性：在漫长的会话中让众多微弱线索持续保有活性。 在前沿模型上，任务瞬间瓦解。micro-cc 和 Claude Code 在 Claude Opus 5.5 上分别取得 0.9986 和 1.000 的分数，用时 22 和 25 分钟。 一项原本耗时数周的业务现在只需几分钟和几美元；在前沿水平之下，harness 决定模型能走多远。
